---
title: "Local Operator Environment"
execute:
  eval: false
engine: markdown
---

`direnv` is an optional operator convenience, not part of the scientific
environment. The container image fixes the R ABI and system libraries; the
project-local `uvr` library fixes R packages.

::: {.manual-prereq title="Enable The Local Convenience Layer"}

Install `direnv`, enable its shell hook, and run `direnv allow` from the
repository root after emitting this file.

:::

::: {.manual-procedure .emit-generic file="{{ emit.project_root }}/.envrc" title="Emit The Local direnv Contract"}

```bash
# Generated from notebooks/infrastructure/10_page-direnv.qmd.
export PROJECT_DIR="$(CDPATH= cd -- "$(dirname -- "$BASH_SOURCE")" && pwd)"
PATH_add "$PROJECT_DIR/scripts"
```

:::

The file deliberately does not set library or compiler paths. Those belong
inside the container.

::: {.manual-check title="Verify The Activated Environment"}

```sh
direnv allow
test "$PROJECT_DIR" = "$PWD"
type render-isolated
type mdg-healthshed-clinic-data
```

:::
